description: Generalist RL agent over the six worldwide starter decks, trained against a FROZEN snapshot of a prior run (the v0.20 greedy run's final policy) as the opponent instead of the scripted greedy. opponent='pool' loads /workspace/opponent_pool.json (a single MaskableRecurrentPPO snapshot, standard_lite_deck_v2 / 8850 — obs-compatible with this run). Periodic checkpoints are on so this run itself produces snapshots for a growing league. Cloud-run entrypoint: python tools/run_training_job.py /app/jobs/cloud_starter_decks_vs_snapshot.json
